issues.issue: False-positive flag: '1' is the 'Study 1' label, not an efficacy/safety number.
False-positive flag: '2' is the 'Study 2' label, not an efficacy/safety number.
False-positive flag: p<0.001 is supported by the citation 'p < .001 for both doses'; the flag arises only from .001 vs 0.001 formatting.
False-positive flag: the '2%' in 'at least 2% more than placebo' is standard label threshold wording, not an uncited efficacy/safety datum.
False-positive flag: '16' refers to the approved age cutoff (patients 16 and older), which is supported by the cited indication.
False-positive flag: 'three' pivotal trials is supported by the cited 'three adequate and well controlled pivotal trials'.
